constants.why: 2^12, the number of basis states of the largest system studied (N=12 spins)

constants.why: standard deviation of the normal initialisation of all parameters (the --init default of method/run.py; no run overrides it)

constants.name: start_b_field
constants.why: constant added to the initial fields a_i in the symmetry-broken start B (--field-init 0.5)

constants.name: single_flip_fraction
constants.why: share of Metropolis proposals that flip one spin (hard-coded in method/run.py)

constants.name: global_flip_fraction
constants.why: share of Metropolis proposals that flip all spins (hard-coded in method/run.py)

constants.name: lbfgs_max_iterations
constants.why: iteration cap of the sampling-free L-BFGS reference (the --exact-maxiter default of method/run.py)

constants.name: significance_level
constants.why: threshold against which the uncorrected paired tests are read (research.yaml ambition.alpha)

constants.name: h4_window
constants.why: registered window of hypothesis H4: the mean-field error peak must lie within this distance of Gamma=1

constants.why: relative energy error above which a run is counted as a poor state in the checks table
